verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's docs state that API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses. That implies API-to-UI parity by design. The gateway also exposes workspaces as OpenAI-compatible models for programmatic agent tasks. Probes found no published OpenAPI spec on the docs site and there is no endpoint-by-endpoint reference, so parity rests on a single architectural claim. missing for 10: published API reference or OpenAPI spec enumerating UI-equivalent endpoints, independent/hands-on confirmation that all UI features (admin, channels, memory, automations) are reachable via API

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: An API key is a personal access token that lets external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses.
The gateway exposes each of your workspaces as an OpenAI-compatible model, so any OpenAI-style client can run agent tasks in a real workspace.
